title: Directing Claude Code on an iPhone game: isolated tests and positive controls
summary: KenOfEarth describes directing Claude Code on Catnip Arcade with separate worktrees and Simulators, a decision log, and unattended test jobs. An iOS team can check expected test counts and require planted controls to fire before accepting a clean report; the author keeps visual and audio approval with the human.
takeaway: Isolate each agent’s Simulator, verify expected test counts, and prove the diagnostic harness detects known cases before trusting empty results or a clean report.
